test_copy_on_write_dataframe_methods: test the copy-on-write behavior of DataFrame methods like reset_index, drop, reindex, and select_dtypes
test_copy_on_write_series_methods: test the copy-on-write behavior of Series methods like rename, reindex, astype, and swaplevel
test_copy_keyword_shares_memory: test the copy keyword parameter controls memory sharing between original and modified DataFrames
test_mutating_triggers_copy_on_write: test that mutating a shallow copy triggers copy-on-write and breaks memory sharing for affected columns
test_chained_dataframe_operations_cow: test copy-on-write correctness across chained DataFrame operations like rename and select_dtypes
